waiver_of_premium.value: The rider's own future premiums are waived for 3 years after a valid claim for early-stage cancer or carcinoma in situ (cancer option). Base policy premiums are not waived.
waiver_of_premium.doc: HDFC Life Health Plus Rider Linked Sales Brochure (product page link)
waiver_of_premium.quote: Future premiums shall be waived for a period of 3 years under this rider on a valid claim of Early Stage Cancer or Carcinoma-in-situ (CIS) diagnosis
waiver_of_premium.note: Waives only this rider's premium, so it is not a waiver of the ULIP premium.

critical_illness.value: Option A: lump sum of the rider sum assured on diagnosis of any of 60 critical illnesses; the cover then ends. Option B, cancer: 100% on major cancer less earlier claims; 25% (up to Rs 12,50,000) on early-stage cancer or carcinoma in situ, at most two minor claims. Elite cover option raises the sum assured 5% a year. Return of premium option available. Only one of A and B can be chosen.
critical_illness.doc: HDFC Life Health Plus Rider Linked Sales Brochure (product page link)
critical_illness.quote: The Rider Sum Assured shall be paid as a lumpsum on diagnosis of any of the covered critical illnesses
critical_illness.note: Condition counts: 60 critical illnesses (stated in the brochure).
